# Hollister Ranch 107 — Rancho Alegria

> Rancho Alegria is Parcel 107 of Hollister Ranch: 113 private bluff-top acres on California's Gaviota Coast in Santa Barbara County, directly above the Razor Blades surf break. It was designed and built from the ground up, beginning in 1987, by Harold Clavin, M.D., and his wife Jeanette Clavin, and is held by the Clavin family. This is the family's own official website; it is for information only and does not handle bookings.

## Key facts

- Name: Rancho Alegria (Hollister Ranch Parcel 107)
- Size: 113 acres, bluff-top, ocean views across the Santa Barbara Channel
- Location: Western Hollister Ranch, Gaviota Coast, Santa Barbara County, California — about 30 minutes from Santa Barbara and 2 hours 15 minutes from Los Angeles
- Surf: fronts Razor Blades, the named point break closest to the ranch's Gaviota gate
- Buildings and amenities: single-level hacienda-style main house, separate red-tile guest house, private hot tub (spa), full-size ocean-view tennis court
- Access: Hollister Ranch is private and gated with a single guarded entrance; not open to the public
- Builders: Harold Clavin, M.D. (Los Angeles plastic and reconstructive surgeon) and Jeanette Clavin
- Today: a family ranch where three generations of Clavins gather — beach walks at low tide, sunsets from the bluff, and resident wildlife including bobcats and California quail
- Timeline: 1987 land; 1988 grading; 1989 tennis court; 1990 guest house; main house, gardens and orchard followed; today three generations of the family
